focus: Typed input intake into FigJam-only output
noveltyJustification: The source-type split connects Figma MCP limits to Product Owner source-status rules and reveals a separate output-mode boundary.
keyQuestions: How should Product Owner ingest screenshots, Figma flows, and product documentation into a FigJam-only output?
answeredQuestions: How should Product Owner ingest screenshots, Figma flows, and product documentation into a FigJam-only output?

label: Input handling should branch by source type before flow synthesis: local Figma MCP provides Figma file/node context, while Product Owner Doc Mode supplies source classification and authority rules for written product material. Treating all three inputs as the same MCP payload would cross two documented boundaries. [INFERENCE: based on .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/mcp-wiring.md:32 and AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-product-owner/references/doc-mode.md:141]

For a Figma flow, accept a Figma URL, extract its fileKey and optional nodeId, discover the live tool schema, then read the smallest relevant node scope and referenced images. The local manual says tools and schemas can change under @latest and recommends node-scoped reads when the schema permits because responses can be token-heavy. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/mcp-wiring.md:95] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/mcp-wiring.md:129] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/mcp-wiring.md:146]

The local MCP manual documents file/node retrieval and downloading Figma-referenced images, but no direct screenshot-upload or OCR tool. The separate screenshot-url CLI command captures a URL or recreates a webpage into Figma, so it does not establish a supported path for arbitrary attached screenshots. Use screenshots as visual source evidence and keep unobserved transitions marked unknown until supported. [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/mcp-wiring.md:112] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/figma-cli-reference.md:250] [INFERENCE: based on .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling/mcp-figma/references/mcp-wiring.md:112 and AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-product-owner/references/doc-mode.md:149]

For product docs, classify each material claim as current behavior, approved direction, proposal, retired, or unknown; keep status markers with the claim, and stop silent reconciliation when no scoped source authority resolves a conflict. This provides the source-to-transition evidence rules for a FigJam flow derived from written requirements. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-product-owner/references/doc-mode.md:141] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-product-owner/references/doc-mode.md:168] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-product-owner/references/doc-mode.md:181]

FigJam-only output needs a dedicated flow route or explicit mode boundary: current Product Owner Doc Mode promises one Markdown artifact and a Markdown export path, while the parent spec excludes HTML/SVG and requires FigJam as the only output. Keep any normalization model internal and place source/status notes in FigJam text or stickies so the board remains the sole deliverable.
